title: Folic acid alleviates fetal growth restriction induced by gestational Di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate exposure in mice through activating the STAT3/HIF-1alpha/VEGFA signaling pathway.
authors: Xie, Fang; Hou, Mengzhen; Wang, Yingxia; Ling, Xutao; Yu, Yun; Huang, Qianqian; Zhang, Lun; Zhang, Cheng; Yu, Jun; Wang, Jianqing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究叶酸通过STAT3/HIF-1alpha/VEGFA通路缓解DEHP暴露所致胎儿生长受限，仅含分子对接且非TF-DNA互作核心，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP), a ubiquitous environmental pollutant, is extensively utilized in industrial, medical, and food-related applications. In our previous study, we successfully established an mice model of ICP induced by gestational di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) exposure. Our findings suggested that DEHP-induced folic acid (FA) deficiency might contribute to the development of IUGR. However, the potential protective effects of FA supplementation against IUGR resulting from gestational DEHP exposure remain to be elucidated. Notably, administration of DEHP to pregnant mice resulted in a significant reduction in average placental weight and diameter, as well as fetal body weight and crown-rump length. Histological analysis using H&E staining and immunohistochemistry revealed a reduction in the area of placental blood sinuses and the density of CD34(+) micro vessels. Gene expression analysis of placental nutrient transporters demonstrated significant downregulation of glucose transporter Glut1, fatty acid transporters CD36 and Fatp1, as well as amino acid transporter Snat4. Molecular docking analysis indicated that FA exhibited strong binding affinity toward the target protein STAT3. Experimental findings confirmed that FA could enhance placental angiogenesis and alleviate placental hypoplasia and nutrient transport impairments by activating the STAT3/HIF-1alpha/VEGFA signaling pathway, thus preventing IUGR caused by maternal DEHP exposure. These results provide a theoretical foundation for the prevention and treatment of ICP-associated IUGR.
abstract_zh: 邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯（DEHP）作为一种普遍存在的环境污染物，广泛应用于工业、医疗及食品相关领域。在我们先前的研究中，成功建立了由妊娠期邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯（DEHP）暴露诱导的ICP小鼠模型。研究结果表明，DEHP诱导的叶酸（FA）缺乏可能促进IUGR的发生。然而，叶酸补充对妊娠期DEHP暴露所致IUGR的潜在保护作用仍有待阐明。值得注意的是，对孕鼠施用DEHP导致平均胎盘重量和直径、胎儿体重及顶臀长显著降低。通过H&E染色和免疫组化进行的组织学分析显示，胎盘血窦面积和CD34(+)微血管密度减少。胎盘营养转运体基因表达分析表明，葡萄糖转运体Glut1、脂肪酸转运体CD36和Fatp1以及氨基酸转运体Snat4显著下调。分子对接分析显示，叶酸对靶蛋白STAT3表现出强结合亲和力。实验证实，叶酸可通过激活STAT3/HIF-1alpha/VEGFA信号通路增强胎盘血管生成，缓解胎盘发育不全和营养转运障碍，从而预防母体DEHP暴露引起的IUGR。这些结果为ICP相关IUGR的预防和治疗提供了理论基础。
